plant_name: Synthetic 30 MWp plant, Jodhpur region, Rajasthan

components.class_detail: Extreme weather event: higher than 93% of the 30 synthetic years (percentile 93)
components.formula: Phi_irr = Shapley contribution of replacing forecast-year POA irradiance with measured POA, all else mixed over orderings

components.class_detail: Mean ambient 19.2 degC, percentile 67 of 30 synthetic years
components.formula: Phi_temp = Shapley contribution of replacing typical ambient temperature with measured; acts via cell temperature and gamma = -0.35%/degC

signals: Inverter status log (n inverters online per hour)
components.formula: Phi_down = Shapley contribution of replacing assumed availability (99.5%) with logged availability

signals: Export setpoint / curtailment flags from grid operator or PPC
components.formula: Phi_curt = Shapley contribution of applying the logged export setpoint (forecast assumes none)
Phi_soil = Shapley contribution of replacing assumed 2.0% soiling with the soiling-station series

signals: Periodic flash test / IV-curve degradation estimate
components.formula: Phi_deg = Shapley contribution of replacing assumed 0.5%/yr x age with measured degradation

signals: Calibration on clean, unconstrained, high-irradiance hours in the first 21 days
components.formula: Phi_model = Shapley contribution of replacing the financing-model derate (mismatch, wiring, LID, shading bundle) with the derate calibrated from measured data

interaction.note: Non-additive part: the sum of Shapley values minus the sum of isolated effects. In the Shapley view it is already shared fairly between causes; shown here for transparency.

unexplained.message: 103,855 kWh of the gap is NOT explained by the data we hold. It is larger than input uncertainty alone can produce (90% band -104,986 to -100,373 kWh).
data_that_would_reduce_it: String-level current logs / combiner-box data (finds partial-string failures)
Thermal imaging or an IV-curve scan of suspect arrays
A shading survey of new structures or vegetation near the site
Inverter derating and MPPT-fault event codes not currently in the status log
unexplained.formula: U = measured actual - simulated actual (all causes on). Reconciliation: sum(causes) + U = gap.

weather.statement: higher than 93% of the 30 synthetic years (percentile 93)

data_quality_flags: SYNTHETIC DATA: plant, outages, curtailment and weather are simulated (weather shaped like Rajasthan, not measured).
Irradiance sensor: 40 hours missing and gap-filled with forecast-year values.
Soiling comes from a soiling station with unknown calibration bias.
Tariff INR 2.70/kWh is an assumption, not a PPA figure.
Curtailment profile is illustrative, shaped like reported 2026 patterns.

evidence.title: 2 short inverter trips
evidence.detail: Single-inverter trips logged in the period (aggregate)

evidence.title: Feb 2026 irradiance
evidence.detail: 137 kWh/m2 measured vs 132 typical (+4.0%); percentile 93 of 30 synthetic years

evidence.title: Mean ambient temperature
evidence.detail: 19.2 degC measured vs 18.9 degC typical; percentile 67

evidence.title: Soiling station series
evidence.detail: Mean 2.71% vs 2.00% assumed; peak 5.0% on 2026-02-05; 1 cleanings logged

evidence.title: Model calibration
evidence.detail: Derate calibrated to 0.9493 vs 0.970 in the financing model, using 104 clean, unconstrained, high-irradiance hours. Note: any irradiance-sensor bias is absorbed into this number.

monte_carlo.perturbed: irradiance sensor bias (sd 1.0%), ambient temp offset (sd 0.8 degC), soiling-station offset (sd 0.4 pts), flash-test error (sd 0.1 pts), meter (sd 0.3%); derate recalibrated each sample

narrative.text: In February 2026, the synthetic plant delivered 3,974 MWh against a forecast of 4,014 MWh: 41 MWh (1.0%) below forecast, worth about INR 1.1 lakh at the assumed tariff. Irradiance vs typical year added 212.1 MWh [luck, medium confidence] (higher than 93% of the 30 synthetic years (percentile 93)) Forecast model bias cost 86.9 MWh [predictable, low confidence]. Degradation vs assumption cost 44.2 MWh [predictable, medium confidence]. Soiling above assumption cost 30.4 MWh [controllable, low confidence]. 103.9 MWh remains unexplained and is larger than measurement uncertainty can account for (90% band -105.0 to -100.4 MWh).
